title: Jaccard Metric Losses: Optimizing the Jaccard Index with Soft Labels
mechanism: An IoU loss that is a true metric on [0,1], so it is minimised at prediction = soft target; this lets label smoothing and knowledge distillation be combined with an IoU loss, which the L1 soft Jaccard / soft Dice cannot do (they push soft-label predictions to 0/1).
adaptation: Distil the 5-seed FINAL (or PF) ensemble into one U-Net++ R34: CE + JML on hard labels plus CE + JML on teacher soft maps, over the 478 train cells and the 11.9k pool. JML only on crack and inactive (paper warns class-wise JML amplifies extreme minority classes), computed over the whole batch so it matches our pooled IoU (paper warns per-GPU small batches optimise per-image IoU), active classes PRESENT. House soft Dice must be replaced, since it breaks on soft targets.
min_experiment: Arm JML-KD student (5 seeds) vs SUP100 single (and SUP100-PF). Metrics clean-49 crack IoU, relF1@2, inactive IoU; E1 secondary. Kill if 5-seed mean crack IoU < SUP100 + 0.009 (half the ensemble gap) and relF1@2 n.d.
evidence: R: CE+JML beats CE alone by typically > 2% mIoU on Cityscapes, VOC, ADE20K over 13 models; JML-KD beats SOTA segmentation KD (e.g. DL3-R18 VOC 74.42 hard JML vs 75.89 JML-KD); BLS best at k=3, eps 0.5; with soft labels L1 soft Jaccard underperforms hard labels on VOC (74.13 vs 74.42).
prior_overlap: Partial: pseudo-label SSL at 100% with the 11.9k pool was n.d., but it used an EMA teacher of the same model, hard / tolerant labels and the old Dice. A 5-model ensemble teacher with soft targets and a soft-compatible IoU loss is untested.

alt_notes.adaptation: Distil the 5-seed FINAL (or PF) ensemble into one U-Net++ R34 with CE + JML on teacher soft maps over the 478 train cells plus the 11.9k pool; JML only on crack + inactive, computed per batch to match pooled IoU; active classes filtered by teacher confidence (LABEL). House soft Dice must be replaced, since it breaks on soft targets.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: CE+JML hard + (CE+JML) on FINAL ensemble soft maps, train+pool, 5 seeds; control: same teacher with plain KL; baseline SUP100 single (repeat on PF). Metric crack IoU (clean 49, val bias), relF1@2, inactive IoU, E1 inactive. Kill: crack IoU < SUP100 + 0.009 (half the ensemble gap) and relF1@2 n.d.
